items.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998
items.q: The act was, the company was the Will Maston trio... That’s where he came from. He was our opening act... we’d play... all the big eastern houses.

ctx.x: The years — you did some tours with Sinatra, on the road?

Yes. Yeah, we closed all the theaters. We were the end of vaudeville. The act was, the company was the Will Maston trio, which was the father and uncle and the center of the trio was Sam Davis Junior, he was ten years old, and they were a dance trio. That’s where he came from. He was our opening act, and then we’d always have an animal act because Sinatra and I both loved animal acts. And they we’d play, we closed all the great houses: Chicago, Detroit, Philadelphia, Washington, all the big eastern houses. That…
